title: Harmonize fallback variant interop: tokenizer/context/tooling audit + maintenance playbook
creator: Priya Narayanan
description: Objective: produce a reproducible audit and an operational playbook to ensure all fallback model variants are compatible along three axes: tokenizer behavior (tokenization and detokenization parity), context/KV cache semantics (prefix/rollover/eviction interoperability), and tooling integrations (inference runtime flags, quantization artifacts, and SDK helpers). This ticket scopes the discovery audit, automated tests, remediation plans, and a continuous-maintenance cadence to keep the compatibility matrix current for SmartRouting region/tier fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical compatibility matrix (CSV) with model variant rows and tokenizer/context/tooling columns published to the shared repo
Automated end-to-end tests (CI job) that validate tokenization roundtrip and a minimal KV-cache replay scenario for each variant pair
Playbook document with step-by-step remediation actions and clear rollback criteria for production rollouts
Telemetry signals defined and wired to Console dashboards and Alert rules for regression detection
All high-risk incompatibilities have assigned mitigation tasks or temporary routing policy exceptions before the due_date
audit_plan: Inventory: generate a list of active model variants used in hosted, dedicated, and private routes (include model metadata UID, tokenizer package, quantization tag)
Tokenization checks: run tokenization/detokenization roundtrip for a shared corpus (50k tokens across domains) and record mismatch rates
Context semantics: execute KV-cache transfer scenarios (cold start, prefix continuation, forced truncation) between variant A -> B and B -> A and capture inference deltas
Tooling hooks: validate runtime flags (disable-attn-optim, kv-mode), quantization artifacts (GGUF vs GGFX), and SDK wrappers for predictable behavior
Regression baseline: compare current results to previous compatibility snapshot (if available) and flag deltas >0.1% tokenization mismatch or any functional breakage
automation_tasks: Add CI job fallback-compat-check that runs tokenization roundtrip and KV-cache smoke for PRs touching model manifests
Create a lightweight python harness (tests/compat_harness.py) that emits normalized diffs and issue links
Schedule nightly telemetry batch to re-run matrix for top 20 high-traffic variants and persist results to S3
Auto-create remediation tickets when tokenization mismatch >0.5% or KV-replay fails for canonical prompts
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Audit): complete automated matrix generation and manual verification with Applied ML - target 2 weeks
Phase 2 (Remediation): land small fixes (tokenizer upgrades, mapping tables) behind canary routing - target 1 week
Phase 3 (Policy): update SmartRouting to include a soft-fail score and route avoidance for flagged variant pairs
Phase 4 (Continuous): enable CI gating and nightly checks; document SLA for matrix refresh cadence (bi-weekly)
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: tokenizer upgrades may change token IDs and silently affect downstream evals. Mitigation: publish tokenizer diffs and require approvals for tokenizer package bump
Risk: KV-cache semantics differ causing hidden state corruption when routing fallback. Mitigation: add conservative fallback TTL and KV-deserialization checks in runtime
Risk: automation false positives. Mitigation: tier results (info/warning/critical) and require human triage for critical failures
